title: Readiness: Staffflow & KPI Sprint Weave
content:
Context / purpose:
This is a compact operational canvas for the next launch sprint (4 weeks) that ties together: staffing runway (who covers which shift/role), KPI trackers for day-zero → day-30, and short-form contingency triggers with immediate actions. Goal is a single-page working doc engineering, product ops, and oncall leads can refer to during the launch window.

How to use:
- Before sprint start: product-ops owns the baseline headcount + skill map and posts an updated RACI to the #launch-room Slack.
- Daily: SRE/ops publishes a 5-line health snapshot in the launch thread (latency, error rate, token-cost burn, active traffic %, rollout %).
- Triage: If a contingency trigger fires, follow the action steps in the "Immediate Actions" section and escalate via the oncall ladder.

Sprint overview (4 weeks):
- Week 0 (preflight): dry-run, smoke-tests, capacity reservation, canary pipeline bake.
- Week 1 (soft launch): 1% traffic, validation prompts, KPI baselines.
- Week 2 (ramp): 5→20% traffic, canary evaluations, customer success probes.
- Week 3 (scale): full rollout to target segment, monitor regression windows.

Staffflow (who covers what):
- Launch lead: Evelyn Park (product-ops) — overall runway, stakeholder comms.
- Oncall SRE primary: Ravi Menon — latency, infra alerts, autoscale.
- Model ops lead: Sofia Alvarez — model rollouts, variant routing, fallback mapping.
- Customer success triage: Benji Carter — top-10 customers on pilot list.
- Overflow roster (nights/weekends): Eng rotation (Alice M., Mateo K., Jordan H.) — see Slack #oncall-rotations for hours.
- Backup escalation: VP Eng (pager) -> CTO (if P0 lingers > 2 hours).

KPI sprint weave (tracked daily / owners):
- Latency p95 (ms) — owner: Ravi — target: <= 120ms; warning: > 160ms; critical: > 250ms.
- Error rate (5m window) — owner: Ravi — target: <0.5%; warning: 0.5-1%; critical: >1.5%.
- Cost per 1k tokens (USD) — owner: product-ops — baseline and rolling delta to evaluate batching/quantization impact.
- Model quality score (automated evals on seed prompts) — owner: Sofia — target: no >5% drop vs baseline.
- Customer success NPS sample (pilot cohort) — owner: Benji — weekly check-ins.
- Throughput (requests/s) — owner: platform-eng — track 15m rolling; correlate to autoscale events.

KPI quick sheet (columns to capture in daily snapshot):
- Date, Latency p95, Error %, Throughput rps, Cost/1k tokens, Quality Delta %, Notes/Incidents.

Contingency triggers (fast checks):
1) Latency p95 breach (>= warning threshold) for 10m:
   - Immediate: throttle non-critical routes (product-ops toggle), enable low-latency routing policy (fallback to optimized model variant).
   - Owner: Ravi + Sofia.
   - Escalate to oncall lead if persists >30m.
2) Error rate critical (>1.5%) for 5m:
   - Immediate: rollback recent model or config rollout, divert traffic to previous stable shard.
   - Owner: Sofia.
   - Notify CS to prepare messaging to affected customers.
3) Quality regression (automated eval shows >5% regression):
   - Immediate: pause A/B traffic to variant, initiate targeted eval on failing prompt set, open PO-XXXX ticket.
   - Owner: product-ops + applied-ml.
4) Cost anomaly (sustained +30% vs baseline for 1h):
   - Immediate: apply burst cap, force quantized profile, and review long-running batch jobs.
   - Owner: product-ops finance liaison.

Immediate Actions checklist (on trigger):
- Call the 15-min launch war room (calendar + #launch-room).
- Attach current KPI snapshot (export from dashboard).
- Assign a single incident commander (IC).
- Triage root cause (infra vs model vs prompt drift).
- Apply temporary mitigation -> verify KPI change -> communicate outward.
- If P0 remains >60m, escalate per chain of command.

Risk notes / open questions (working):
- We currently lack a low-friction toggle for per-route batching; action: infra ticket to add route-level batch config (PO-4988).
- Night/weekend coverage: overflow roster is thin — need one more engineer committed for Week 2 ramp.
- Customer messaging templates: draft in Confluence but needs legal review for regulated customers.

Data sources / dashboards to feed the daily snapshot:
- Console latency dashboard (per-model, per-region).
- Token-cost billing feed (rolling 1h granularity).
- Automated eval pipeline (seed prompt turnout + regression diff).
- Error/event logs (sampled traces).

Meeting cadence during launch window:
- Daily standup (15m) at 09:30 PT — quick KPI readout + blocking items.
- War room if any critical trigger (ad hoc).
- Postmortem and retro (1 week after end of sprint) — owner: product-ops.

Appendix: quick playbook snippets
- Rolling back a model variant: steps 1-4 (Sofia) — keep rollback duration < 10 minutes when possible.
- Enabling fallback routing: toggle policy name "fallback-optimized" in console -> verify 5% traffic shift -> monitor.
- Cost pause: product-ops admin can enforce quota decrease on test keys (see internal admin guide).

Notes to self / TODOs:
- Confirm legal review on customer-facing messaging by 2024-11-10.
- Add one infra engineer to Week 2 overflow roster by 2024-11-15.
- Wire up a daily export job that writes the KPI quick sheet to a shared csv in Drive (owner: product-ops analytics).

Related artifacts: see linked_artifacts above.

Version history (brief):
- 2024-11-05 initial draft (Evelyn).
- 2024-11-12 staffing adjustments after SRE sync (Ravi).
- 2024-12-02 review pass: clarified thresholds and added cost anomaly flow (Benji).

End of doc.
